branch.title: Branch
branch.description: Current branch name, or null if not resolvable.

has_remote.title: Has Remote
has_remote.description: Whether the repository has a configured remote.

remote_name.title: Remote Name
remote_name.description: Name of the remote push/pull uses ('cloud' or 'origin'), or null if there is none.

remote_url.title: Remote Url
remote_url.description: URL of that remote - the upstream repository this checkout is connected to.

ahead.title: Ahead
ahead.description: Number of local commits ahead of the remote.

behind.title: Behind
behind.description: Number of remote commits the local branch is behind.

merging.title: Merging
merging.description: Whether the repository is currently in the middle of a merge.

path.title: Path
path.description: Path of the changed file, relative to the repository root.

status.title: Status
status.description: Git status code for the change (e.g. modified, added, deleted).

staged.title: Staged
staged.description: Whether the change is currently staged.
